messages:
elaine: fyi — customer 'AcmePay' opened a priority ticket: checkout latency spikes under load, causing timeouts. they want a hotfix this week.
raj: thanks. do we have a repro and the scope? p99 on which route?
sam: repro in staging. p99 tokenization+serve on /v1/generate. reproduces with long-history sessions.
frank: this sounds like a KV-cache miss pattern + unexpected seq len. likely root cause of tail latency.
elainE (typo correction): elaine: ^ small typo earlier. intention: propose tradeoff huddle — ship quick mitigation vs schedule SLO work.
raj: need to evaluate impact vs effort. suggest small checklist: 1) roll forward tiny fix (cache pin/evict tweak) 2) monitor for regressions 3) schedule SLO + batching improvements in next sprint.
sam: quick RICE sketch: Reach=high (many checkout calls), Impact=high (timeouts -> lost revenue), Confidence=med, Effort=small for hotfix, large for full SLO rework. so hotfix RICE >> rework.
frank: agree but want guardrails. if hotfix increases error surface elsewhere, we'll roll back. can we ship a canary?
elainE (elaine): elaine: yes canary + feature-flag. canary to 5% traffic in us-east then 25% then full. ops-bot will handle.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: 1768890400 -> 5% -> monitor latency and error budget usage. (auto-notify @oncall)
raj: launch criteria for hotfix: p99 < 500ms on /v1/generate for canary window, no error increase >0.5% absolute, alerts green for 30m. if fail -> rollback.
sam: I'll create a minimal patch: cache TTL adjustment + smoother batching threshold. should be <= 4h work incl tests.
frank: I'll add synthetic checks and a dashboard for the canary group (latency, errors, kv-misses).
elainE (elaine): product asked for faster ship; this compromise works. schedule full SLO/quantization and KV cache redesign in next sprint (2-week spike + followup).
raj: record decision in roadmap: hotfix this week (shiplet), SLO project next sprint with RICE and acceptance criteria. also add to oncall runbook: how to rollback and validate.
ops-bot: incident-bot: noted: thread tagged for postmortem if error budget exceeded or rollback occurs.
sam: quick note on sequencing: we should do hotfix -> observe -> if stable, start SLO spike, else pause spike and stabilize.
frank: thumbs up. also estimate toil: hotfix = low toil; SLO rework = medium-high toil but major long-term reduction.
elainE (elaine): action items: @sam create PR and canary plan (eta 12:00UTC), @frank dashboard + synthetic checks (eta EOD), @raj update roadmap and runbook.
raj: i'll update roadmap and file the RICE spreadsheet row for SLO project.
elainE (elaine): thanks everyone. ping here when canary passes 30m window. :thumbsup:
